# unplayed

> unplayed helps PC gamers discover games in their Steam library they've never played, surface forgotten gems, and conquer their backlog with stats like Dust Score, shelf life, and spending insights.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of unplayed and how it helps you conquer your Steam backlog.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Global rankings of gamers by Dust Score and backlog stats.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in with Steam to import your library and analyze your backlog.
